$comment: Hand-maintained corrections applied on top of what tools/sync-keiyoushi.mjs reads from keiyoushi. Two things live here that the generator cannot know. First, sites that moved or renamed their archive after upstream stopped updating the extension: upstream is not always current, and a source that 404s on every request is worse than one nobody offered. Second, sites verified to be gone: those keep their row and their id forever, because ids are stored on every manga row and must never be reused, but they are marked retired so they stop costing a slot in every sweep. Every entry was checked against the live site on the date it carries; re-check before trusting an old one. The generator merges this file, so these survive a re-run.

en.vyvymangaorg.retired: vyvymanga.org answers 410 Gone; it now redirects to mangaowl.io, which en.mangaowlio already covers

en.lilymanga.note: Upstream still declares mangaSubString = "ys", which is now a yuri-only sub-archive of two titles; the real catalogue is /gl/ with 125. Upstream being stale is exactly why this file exists rather than a generator fix.

en.linkmanga.note: The listing itself works; the ?m_orderby= parameter trips the site's WAF rule and turns a 200 into a challenge. Browsing unsorted is the whole difference between this source working without a solver and not working at all.

en.mangadistrict.retired: same site as the hand-written `mangadistrict` source, which is the better implementation and carries its own rate-limit floor

en.rizzcomic.retired: same site as the hand-written `rizzfables` source, which is the better implementation and carries its own rate-limit floor

en.ryumanga.retired: answers on every path but publishes no Keyoapp listing markup on either / or /series/, so every browse returns nothing

en.artlapsa.retired: upstream rewrote the chapter list and builds the reader from JSON-LD; both are logic rather than data, so no chapter can be read here

en.ritharscans.retired: browse, details and the chapter list work, but the reader is one of the seven functions upstream rewrote and no chapter opens - a chapter list nothing can open is worse than no source

en.vanillascans.retired: the api. subdomain every Iken site answers on returns a bare 404 from Cloudflare on /api/query and /api/genres alike, so no listing, no series and no chapter can be fetched

all.manhuarm.retired: manhuarmtl.com does not connect at all; no path answers

en.manhwa18org.retired: answers 521 on every path - Cloudflare reporting the origin is down, and it has been for the whole check

all.manhwa18cc.retired: the site is up but its archive is gone: /webtoon/ answers 404 and /manga/ answers 403, so nothing can be browsed

en.mangadass.retired: browses and lists chapters, but the reader carries none of the theme's markup - no page-break, no reading-content, no chapter images - so no chapter opens

en.kunmangaonline.retired: declares the slug chapter endpoint upstream and answers 404 on it; the page carries no chapter list and admin-ajax refuses, so all three routes are exhausted

en.zinmanganet.retired: same as kunmangaonline: the declared chapter endpoint 301s away and neither the page nor admin-ajax has the list

en.mangadrama.retired: browses 458 titles and then exposes no chapter list by any of the three routes, and its series pages carry no title either
